brand.seo_title: Expediciones Tropicales · One day tours from San José, Costa Rica
brand.seo_desc: One day tours from San José since 1993: Irazú and Poás volcanoes, Doka coffee, La Paz waterfalls, Tortuga Island, Manuel Antonio, Pacuare rafting. Hotel pickup and bilingual guides.
brand.sub: Volcanoes before breakfast, coffee at noon, back at your San José hotel for dinner. Bilingual guides and door-to-door pickup, since 1993.
tape: Pickup at your hotel in San José
brand.moods_lead: Every tour leaves from San José with pickup at your hotel. Pick the kind of day you want and we bring you back in time for dinner.
brand.footer_blurb: One day tours from San José with a team that has been showing Costa Rica since 1993. Bilingual guides, real lunches, hotel pickup.
brand.band_title: Nothing here rushes. The crater, the coffee, the valley.
brand.band_text: Thirty years of the same roads out of San José. We know which lookout clears first, where lunch tastes like home, and when to just stop and look.
brand.plan_hello: Pura vida! Tell me how many days you have in San José, who is coming and what you would love to see. I will suggest the right day tours.

tours.title: Irazú Volcano, Orosi Valley & Lankester Gardens
tours.lead: A crater above the clouds, eight hundred orchids and a colonial valley, all before dinner.
overview: We drive up the slopes of Irazú, the highest active volcano in Costa Rica, to a crater that on a clear morning shows you both the Atlantic and the Pacific.

On the way down we stop at the Basilica of the Virgin of the Angels in Cartago, walk Lankester Gardens with the University of Costa Rica's collection of orchids and bromeliads, and finish in the Orosi Valley with one of the country's few colonial churches and a home-style lunch.
highlights: Pickup at your hotel in San José
Irazú Volcano National Park and its crater
Basilica of the Virgin of the Angels, Cartago
Lankester Gardens, over 800 species of orchids and bromeliads
Orosi Valley and its colonial church
steps: Early pickup at your hotel in San José
Drive up to Irazú Volcano National Park
Stop at the Basilica in Cartago
Typical lunch in the Orosi Valley
tours.bring: Light jacket or sweater, walking shoes, raincoat, camera and binoculars. It is cold at the summit.

tours.title: Poás Volcano, Doka Coffee, Grecia & Sarchí
tours.lead: The crater, the golden bean and the oxcart painters, in one loop through the coffee hills.
overview: We climb out of the Central Valley past coffee farms, ferns, flowers and strawberry stands to the main crater of Poás and its sulfur fumaroles.
Lunch and the coffee tour happen at Doka Estate. On the way back we stop in Grecia, with its red metal church, and in Sarchí, where the painted oxcarts are still made by hand.
highlights: Pickup at your hotel in San José
Poás Volcano main crater and fumaroles
Lunch and coffee tour at Doka Estate
The metal church of Grecia
Oxcart workshops of Sarchí
steps: Pickup at your hotel in San José
Drive through coffee and strawberry farms
Lunch and coffee tour at Doka Estate
tours.bring: Light jacket, walking shoes, camera and binoculars.

tours.title: Irazú Volcano
tours.lead: A green lagoon inside the crater and, on a good morning, two oceans at once.
overview: The road climbs from coffee farms to fern forest and finally to bare volcanic ground at the summit of Irazú, where a lookout faces the crater and its green lagoon.
We come down through Cartago to visit the Basilica of the Virgin of the Angels and are back in San José early in the afternoon.
highlights: Pickup at your hotel in San José
Crater lookout and green lagoon
Views of both oceans on clear days
Basilica of the Virgin of the Angels
steps: Pickup at your hotel in San José
Drive up to the summit of Irazú
Stop at the Basilica in Cartago
Back at your hotel early afternoon
tours.bring: Light jacket or sweater, walking shoes, camera and binoculars.

tours.title: La Paz Waterfall Gardens
tours.lead: Five waterfalls, a hummingbird garden and a long lunch in the cloud forest.
overview: A late start and an easy day. We drive up into the mountains, where the air cools and the coffee gives way to ferns and strawberry farms.

At La Paz Waterfall Gardens the trails follow white rivers down to the falls, past an aviary, a butterfly observatory, a hummingbird garden, frogs and the jungle cats exhibit. Lunch is a buffet of traditional Costa Rican dishes.
highlights: Pickup at your hotel in San José
Rainforest trails down to the waterfalls
Hummingbird garden and butterfly observatory
Aviary, frogs, serpentarium and jungle cats
Buffet lunch with Costa Rican dishes
steps: Mountain drive past coffee and strawberry farms
tours.bring: Hat, walking shoes, light jacket, raincoat, camera and binoculars.

tours.title: Bay Island Cruise to Tortuga Island
tours.lead: Sail the Gulf of Nicoya to a white sand beach, with ceviche and live music on board.
overview: We leave San José early for Puntarenas and board the Bay Island yacht across the Gulf of Nicoya, passing San Lucas Island, the old prison.

On Tortuga Island there is a Blue Flag beach of soft white sand, time to swim, kayak or zip line, and a buffet lunch prepared by the crew. Fruit, natural drinks, fish ceviche and live music keep the day going on the way back.
highlights: Pickup at your hotel in San José
Yacht across the Gulf of Nicoya
Blue Flag beach on Tortuga Island
Fish ceviche, tropical fruit and live music
Buffet lunch by the crew
steps: Beach time, swimming and optional kayak or canopy
Sail back and drive to San José
not_included: Kayak and canopy on the island
tours.bring: Swimsuit, sunscreen, water shoes, towel, cool clothes and a camera.

tours.title: Manuel Antonio National Park
tours.lead: Monkeys on the trail, sloths in the canopy and a beach where the forest meets the sea.
overview: We leave before dawn and follow the Pacific coast past palm plantations and small villages to the port of Quepos.

Manuel Antonio is closed to cars, so we walk in, crossing a creek. Inside you choose your pace: forest trails with monkeys, iguanas and birds, beaches with coral reefs, or the hike out to Cathedral Point.
highlights: Pickup at your hotel in San José
Coastal drive through Quepos
Forest trails with monkeys, iguanas and sloths
Beaches with coral reefs
Optional hike to Cathedral Point
steps: Pickup before dawn and breakfast on the way
tours.bring: Hat, sunscreen, insect repellent, swimsuit, towel, sandals, camera and binoculars.

tours.title: Pacuare River White Water Rafting
tours.lead: Class III and IV rapids through the rainforest of the Caribbean slope.
overview: Around nineteen miles of warm, fast water down the Pacuare, one of the most beautiful rivers in Central America, with waterfalls pouring straight into the canyon.
The river runs beside the Talamanca range, home of the Cabécar people, through forest where toucans, parrots and monkeys watch you go by. Breakfast and lunch are part of the day.
highlights: Pickup at your hotel in San José
Class III and IV rapids
Waterfalls inside the canyon
Rainforest along the Talamanca range
Breakfast and lunch
steps: Breakfast on the way to the put-in
tours.bring: Shorts, swimsuit, sandals that strap on, sunscreen, towel and a change of clothes. Minimum age 12.

tours.title: The Authentic Rainforest Experience
tours.lead: A river boat, the Selva Verde trails and a gondola gliding through the canopy.
overview: We cross Braulio Carrillo National Park to Sarapiquí for a boat ride on the river, then walk the private trails of Selva Verde Eco Lodge with our naturalist.
After lunch, the Rain Forest Aerial Tram carries you through the treetops on the way back. If you want more adrenaline, swap the gondola for seven zip lines.
highlights: Pickup at your hotel in San José
Drive through Braulio Carrillo National Park
Boat ride on the Sarapiquí River
Guided walk at Selva Verde
Aerial tram through the canopy, or zip lines
steps: Pickup at your hotel in San José
Aerial tram or zip line, then back to San José
tours.bring: Comfortable clothes, closed walking shoes, sunscreen, hat, insect repellent, raincoat and camera.

tours.title: Arenal Volcano with Baldi Hot Springs
tours.lead: Sarchí on the way, lunch facing the volcano and the evening in volcanic water.
overview: A long, slow day north. We stop in Sarchí for its crafts, cross pineapple and cattle country and have lunch in La Fortuna facing Arenal.
The afternoon belongs to Baldi Hot Springs and its mineral pools heated by the volcano. Dinner looks out at Arenal before the ride back to San José.
highlights: Pickup at your hotel in San José
Stop in Sarchí
Lunch with a view of Arenal Volcano
Baldi Hot Springs mineral pools
Dinner facing the volcano
tours.bring: Swimsuit, water shoes, change of clothes, sunscreen, insect repellent and a camera.

tours.title: San José Explorer City Tour
tours.lead: The National Theater, pre-Columbian gold and the Central Market in one afternoon.
overview: A first afternoon in the capital. We visit the lobby of the National Theater, finished in 1897, and the Gold Museum with its pre-Columbian pieces.
Then the Central Market, the Metropolitan Cathedral and an art gallery for souvenirs, with a drive past the university, the old train station and the Legislative Assembly.
highlights: Pickup at your hotel in San José
National Theater lobby
Pre-Columbian Gold Museum
Central Market and Metropolitan Cathedral
Art gallery for souvenirs
steps: Drive past the city landmarks and back
tours.bring: Comfortable walking shoes, an umbrella and a camera.
